evidence_slice: West Berkshire Council's North East Thatcham Masterplan page states that the site is allocated in the adopted West Berkshire Local Plan Review 2023-2041 under Policy SP14 for approximately 2,500 dwellings and associated infrastructure. The adopted Local Plan policy allocates the site for phased delivery of up to approximately 2,500 dwellings, with at least 40% affordable housing and 3% serviced custom/self-build plots. West Berkshire Council adopted the Local Plan Review on 10 June 2025.
